imports.modification_summary: Keeps the declarative-form tool recognition and the form-control-to-schema rules (input types, number and step bounds, temporal formats, option, radio and checkbox choices, labels, fieldset descriptions, duplicate-name handling). Works on an attribute-only DOM model from a CDP DOMSnapshot instead of the live DOM; removes tool registration, listeners, submission, respondWith and every page mutation; never emits a control value; omits password controls and flags the tool; bounds every string and collection and keeps them free of controls and lone surrogates.
imports.authority_delta: Read-only page data only; no execution, input, navigation or exposure authority.
qualification: native discovery test with page-script traps and a trap control

not_imported.reason: The schema subset is produced directly by the adapted form rules and re-checked by the Rust host validator; no generic JSON Schema handling is needed for read-only discovery.
A second channel to the browser (rejected in WEB_CAPABILITIES_DECISION.md).
